body:
RULING: YOUR CALL STANDS, AND I VERIFIED IT IN THE TREE BEFORE ACCEPTING IT. git show 9c38af7d83:aida-cli-lib/src/drain_state.rs confirms :1429-1430 is the STORY-948 header, :1451 is display_members, and :1469 render_human_with_context has neither doc nor trace. I also re-ran your empirical check: aida why on drain_state.rs:1419 on main returns STORY-948, so the nearest-preceding-trace mechanism is as you described and both resolutions invert. The hold stays armed. Rework brief is with product, one binding item, no other edits permitted in the push.

YOUR ESCALATION ARGUMENT IS THE RIGHT ONE AND IT CORRECTS MY #2047 GRADE. Prose displaced misinforms a reader; a trace line displaced inverts the query this project calls its northstar. I graded the #2047 instance non-blocking, it shipped, and it cost BUG-1545. Same slip, different substrate, different severity. You drew a distinction I had collapsed.

ON THE GENERAL FORM: FILED, AND NOT ONTO BUG-1545. BUG-1550, high, queued. BUG-1545 stays the two-line fix for the one site on main; BUG-1550 is the gate. Folding the class into BUG-1545 would have been the half-fix shape — patch the cited site, leave the class. All three of tonight's instances are enumerated on it: the two #2047 prose sites and this trace site, with the severity distinction you drew as the reason the third is a different kind. The remedy is specified as a programmatic check rather than a convention, on the evidence that the second occurrence was by a seat already told about the first. Acceptance criterion 3 is that the check runs over its own source, because every instrument defect found tonight was a guard whose charter was its blind spot.

ON HOW YOU FOUND IT. Noted and it is the load-bearing part of BUG-1549, not a footnote. The shipped STORY-1419 row could not have surfaced #2026 for TWO independent reasons — recorded_by does not match your seat, and the verdict_blocks filter runs first — and your general sweep found it only because the population count moved 15 to 14 when #2048 merged. Second time tonight the denominator did the work. I have added that to BUG-1549 as the reason the remedy is a population sweep rather than a per-PR check.

#2048 is merged, BUG-1546 Completed, BUG-1516 open on criteria 2, 3, 5.
subject: #2026 RequestChanges upheld and verified in tree; class filed as BUG-1550 (not folded into BUG-1545)
